summary: OccHealthInfluenzaEditAll is a UserControl within HSPnet that manages editing and tracking occupational health influenza immunization status for enrollments, allowing batch or single edits, status updates, and season selections for students.
purpose: To facilitate the bulk editing of influenza immunization records for student enrollments, including tracking immunization status, flu season, and integrating immunization updates into student prerequisite records. It enables workflow-driven batch processing, validation, and UI management for occupational health influenza requirements.

workflows.name: Bulk Edit Influenza Immunization Status
steps: User loads the bulk edit page with filtered enrollments.
Grid populates influenza status and flu season dropdowns for each row using code lists.
User changes dropdowns and marks rows as dirty via JavaScript.
User triggers Save All, Save Edit Next, or Save for single record.
System reads dirty flags, updates student immunization records, and validates updates.
If validation passes, redirects to Enrollment or EnrollmentEditAll as appropriate.
If fewer than 14 rows, hides Save All/Cancel header buttons.
Handles read-only mode by disabling edit fields and hiding relevant controls.

workflows.name: Row/Record Update
steps: On row command, checks if row is dirty.
Updates student immunization record with influenza status and selected flu season.
Handles H1N1-specific logic based on flag.
On successful update and no warnings, redirects; otherwise, stays for correction.

business_rules: Hide Save All and Cancel header buttons if fewer than 14 rows.
Remove Save/Edit controls in read-only mode.
H1N1 flag determines alternative influenza codes and admin date fields.
If Today >= Oct 1 and admin date not set, defaults flu season selection to current year.
validations: Checks for dirty rows before saving.
Dropdown values validated against available code lists.
System generates warnings if validations fail; prevents redirect until resolved.
calculations: Determines default flu season based on today's date and admin date presence.
Calculates next flu season year for admin date dropdowns.
conditions: EnrollmentID == 0: Header Save All/Cancel hidden if <14 rows.
blnReadOnly: disables editing and hides Save/Edit controls.
H1N1: uses alternate codes and flu season fields.
system_behavior: Populates dropdowns for status codes and seasons based on fetched code lists and year data.
Handles async and normal postbacks for JavaScript setup.
Registers and executes JavaScript for dirty tracking and dropdown change events.
Binds grid data and manages row, header, footer states accordingly.
dependencies: Uses Codes.CodeSearch for flu immunization code lists.
Depends on TotalYearType.FluSeasonList for flu season dropdowns.
Integrates with StudentPrerequisites update method for immunization record changes.
exceptions: Validation errors generate warnings and prevent redirect.
Missing UserSession cancels data source selection.
Non-valid UUIDs in related keys ignored during data binding.
